d: To the outside world their marriages seemed happy. They were loving parents living comfortable lives.
They were too young to drink or vote but they were not too young to commit the most brutal of crimes.
Finding out why Caroline stabbed her grandchildren, how a teenage love triangle led to a murderous confrontation, and what a jealous mother `Ma' did to protect her son.
Why did Sarah and Kathleen kill their sisters? How did Betty implicate her twin in her husband's murder? Find out what happens when sisterly love turns sour.
Why did respectable suburban housewives Socorro, Robin and Marybeth kill their own children? Meet the women who murdered those who loved them the most.
Why did 17 year old Heather attack her mother with a hammer? How did privileged daughter Elizabeth convince her boyfriend to murder her wealthy parents?
In the early 1900s, Martha Rendell was hanged for torturing and murdering her husband's children. A look at the events that prompted her to commit such unspeakable acts of violence.
Alice Mitchell murders her lover after their relationship is forbidden  Susan Wright murders her adulterous husband  Larissa Schuster dissolves her husband's body in a barrel of acid.
